sourceFacts.fact: One shared p-V frame. Vertical p axis points upward; horizontal V axis points rightward. Both axes are solid, meeting at the labelled origin 0. No numbered scale or independent numerical ticks are printed.

p_1 and p_2 label two distinct horizontal levels on the vertical axis; p_2 is above p_1. The p_2 dashed guide runs from the vertical axis to state 2 and crosses the lower curve. The p_1 dashed guide runs from the vertical axis to state 1; its horizontal continuation from state 1 to state 1' is a solid process segment.

V_1, V_2, V' label three projections on the horizontal axis, ordered left to right. Dashed vertical guides connect V_1 to state 1, V_2 to state 2, and V' to state 1'. The V_2 guide crosses the lower curve and the horizontal process; the V' guide also crosses the lower curve before reaching state 1'.

State 1 is the lower-left process junction on the lower curve at the p_1 level and V_1 projection. State 2 is above and right of state 1 on the upper curve at p_2 and V_2. State 1' is to the right of both states on that same upper curve, sharing the p_1 level with state 1, at V'. The prime belongs to the intermediate state label, not a fourth state. The volume prime is V', not V_1'.

A solid, smooth decreasing, flattening curve extends from the upper-left interior, passes through state 1, continues across the V_2 and V' guide lines, and ends in the lower-right interior above the volume axis. It is not only the portion touching state 1, and is not dashed.

A second solid, smooth decreasing, flattening curve starts farther right in the upper interior, passes through state 2 and then state 1', and continues beyond state 1' into the lower-right interior. It stays above the lower curve over their shared visible horizontal range. Only the segment between 1' and 2 is the directed process requested in q2; the complete curve remains visible.

A solid horizontal process connects 1 to 1', with a rightward semantic arrow on the segment. State 2's vertical projection intersects the interior of this segment; this crossing is not an additional labelled state.
An arrow on the upper curve between 1' and 2 points up-left toward 2. The directed process therefore follows 1' to 2 along the curve, not along a straight chord or an independent line.
